segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. How can I help?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Hi Maya, this is Evan with Northbridge Analytics. Yeah, so we need to add 12 seats for our operations team starting May 1. I just want to make sure it lines up with our current renewal.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Sure, I can help with that. Can I confirm the account admin email on file?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. I’m in the billing tool now. You’re currently on 48 seats, annual term through November 30, 2026, billed at $74 per seat per month. Adding 12 seats would bring you to 60, and the prorated amount from May 1 through November 30 is $6,216 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That matches what I had. Can you make those seats available today, but have billing start May 1?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yes. I’ll provision the 12 seats in the admin console now and set the billing effective date to May 1. The invoice will be generated on May 2 and sent to billing@northbridgeanalytics.com.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Do I need to sign anything for that count?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: No signature needed for this quantity. I’ve added it under ticket 284917, and the admin console now shows 60 available seats. You should be able to assign them right away.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: I see them. That’s all I needed, thanks.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You’re welcome. I’ll send a short confirmation email with the prorated amount and ticket number. Have a good one.
